Product ID: DEMO-LLM-001
Product Name: Synthetic Renewal Serum
SKU: DEMOLLM01

Description:
A synthetic demo product for exercising tier 6 (LLM reasoning): its only
forbidden-adjacent ingredient is a naming-convention variant that tiers 1-5
cannot resolve on their own (see ARCHITECTURE.md Section 6). Not part of the
provided sample dataset -- used by test_routes_evaluate_llm.py and the Loom
demo script in docs/LOOM_NOTES.md.

Ingredients / Chemical Formulas:
- Aqua
- Glycerin
- D-Glucopyranose
